title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature is crucial for handling API requests with JSON or URL-encoded payloads, enabling yantraverse to support a wider range of use cases and improve its overall usability. It will provide automatic parsing of request bodies into JavaScript objects, making it easier for developers to work with request data. This feature will also include error handling for invalid or malformed request bodies
testCases: Test error handling for invalid JSON
Test error handling for invalid URL-encoded data
acceptance: The feature is considered complete when all test cases pass, and the documentation is updated to reflect the new functionality. Request bodies are correctly parsed into JavaScript objects, and errors are properly handled and logged
reason: This feature is essential for supporting common API use cases and improving the framework's overall usability and adoption rate
